notes: Default dialect coverage is measured by executable regression cases that use PostgreSQL-compatible SQL. Official syntax coverage is tracked in postgresql_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
MySQL coverage is measured by executable dialect cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in mysql_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Oracle coverage is measured by executable dialect cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in oracle_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
SQL Server coverage is measured by executable dialect cases, including official HOOK_ONLY cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in sqlserver_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Dameng coverage is measured by executable dialect cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in dameng_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Vastbase PostgreSQL compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and executable PostgreSQL-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Vastbase MySQL compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and executable MySQL-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Vastbase Oracle compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and executable Oracle-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Vastbase SQL Server compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and executable SQL Server-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
